decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The works hereby approved shall only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree.

The crown lifting works shall not exceed the creation of 8m clearance between the ground and lowest remaining foliage, and shall not include any cutting of main branches, or infliction of large wounds to main branches or to the trunk. Crown lifting works shall be limited to pruning of the small diameter pendulous growth to achieve the objective.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree.

The reduction of branches in the crown shall be limited to lateral branches on the east and west side of the crown only. This branch reduction shall be limited to selected branches only, which overhang the boundary lines, and shall not exceed that which is necessary to clear the boundary line, or shall not exceed 2m of reduction in length - whichever comes first.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).
description: Works to a tree covered by LBE ORDER NO 65 1977: London plane (T1) raise crown to 8m above ground level, removing low pendulous growth, remove massaria infected branches, reduce left and right sides back to the boundary line by up to 2m.
